message.content:
This is a microphone, which falls in heading 8518. Subheading 8518.10 covers microphones and stands therefor. Within it, 8518.10.80 covers other microphones, and 8518.10.40 covers microphones with a frequency range of 300 Hz to 3.4 kHz and a diameter not over 10 mm, with height not over 3 mm, which is a specific type for telecommunications. A boom microphone for an aviation headset is probably the "other" category. The 8518.10.80 subheading is split into statistical suffixes: 8518.10.8010 for the "Other" of 8518.10.80, and so on. I recall the HTSUS has 8518.10.80.00 with a statistical suffix of 60 for other microphones. I am not fully sure, but I believe 8518.10.8060 is the "Other" entry, and I will go with that.

{"hts_code": "8518.10.8060", "reason": "Boom microphones for aviation headsets are microphones of heading 8518, falling under subheading 8518.10.80 for other microphones, with the statistical suffix I recall for the residual entry."}
